message.content:
A **grade-to-percentage calculator** converts points earned into a percentage using **\( \text{grade \%} = (\text{score} \div \text{total points}) \times 100 \)**.[1][2][3]

- Example: **38 out of 50** = **76%** because \( (38 \div 50) \times 100 = 76 \).[1]
- If you want the **points needed** for a target percentage, multiply the target percentage by the total points and divide by 100.[1][3]
- Example: to get **80% on a 50-point test**, you need **40 points**.[1]

If you want, I can also make a quick calculator for you—just send:
- **score earned**
- **total points possible**
